subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: Should DeepSeek completions permanently default to the stable-prefix plus trailing system-carrier strategy with a public `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache` override?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well-proven, but repository policy treats new config/default surfaces and provider-specific upgrade behavior as an owner decision; the open alternative PR also means automation cannot choose the canonical contract.

options.title: Adopt DeepSeek default
options.body: Keep the additive override and DeepSeek automatic default, then resolve current-main conflicts and refresh exact-head focused and live proof.

options.title: Keep the mode opt-in
options.body: Expose the compatibility field without changing existing DeepSeek defaults, accepting that affected users must configure the workaround explicitly.

options.title: Use an internal capability
options.body: Avoid a public config field and encode the provider behavior in maintained capability metadata, with any operator override deferred until a concrete need is approved.

recommendation.title: Adopt DeepSeek default
recommendation.body: Keep the additive override and DeepSeek automatic default, then resolve current-main conflicts and refresh exact-head focused and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to the affected provider package boundary and makes them the strongest candidate to settle the permanent public/default contract.
